title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-27
content:
2026-03-27 PM scratchpad

Top priorities for today:
- Finalize PRD edits for Smart Routing v2 (must ship beta config to Dedicated next week).
- Follow up with infra on autoscaling policy e2e tests.
- Launch checklist prep for canary rollout (internal beta).

Meetings:
- 09:30 — Sync w/ Evelyn (infra & runtime) — final perf numbers for quantized variants.
  Notes: need 95th pct latency under 120ms for seq len 256; Evelyn will rerun stress with kv-cache on. Action: Evelyn to share CSV by EOD.
- 11:00 — Stakeholder review (GTM + CS + SRE) — demo and risk discussion.
  Notes: GTM wants migration playbook; CS needs rollback docs and messaging. PRD must include troubleshooting matrix.
- 14:00 — Design review w/ UX for console rollout (route policy UI).
  Notes: Tomás to prototype dropdown with fallback policy toggle.

PRD edits to do (quick list):
- Add "Rollback & Fallback" section (owner: Marco) — include automatic fallback to compatible model variant and region routing examples.
- Add troubleshooting matrix (owner: Priya) — include common errors (KV cache miss, OOM, timeout) and suggested mitigations.
- Clarify SLA targets for Dedicated vs Hosted (owner: Marco) — numeric table: p50/p95/p99 latency & throughput per GPU SKU.
- Acceptance criteria: must include end-to-end canary path + smoke tests for billing/usage tagging.

Open questions / Risks:
- Can Dedicated autoscaler honor customer burst policy while preserving SLA? (infra to confirm)
- Monitoring retention for per-route token-level metrics — cost/retention tradeoff (observability team).
- Legal review for private deployments in EU (data residency language) — flagged to security/compliance.

Launch checklist (initial internal beta):
- [ ] PRD finalized + sign-off (product, infra, SRE, CS).
- [ ] Canary config created and uploaded to dedicated cluster (infra).
- [ ] Health checks & smoke tests automated (release-eng).
- [ ] Billing tagging verified in staging (finance).
- [ ] Rollback playbook written (CS + product).
- [ ] Customer-facing doc draft (CS) + internal runbook (SRE).
- [ ] Post-launch monitoring dashboard (console team) — p50/p95 latency, error rate, tokens/sec.

Action items (owners):
- Marco: finish "Rollback & Fallback" section, clarify SLA numbers, update acceptance criteria — due 2026-03-28.
- Evelyn: rerun perf tests with kv-cache + quantization, share CSV and sample traces — due EOD 2026-03-27.
- Tomás: wireframe routing UI; bring prototype to Wed design review — due 2026-03-30.
- Priya: draft troubleshooting matrix + common support responses — due 2026-03-29.
- Release Eng: automate smoke test for canary path (coordinate with infra) — due 2026-04-01.

Quick notes / scratch ideas:
- Consider adding a "cost bucket" tag on routes so customers can opt-in to cost-optimized model variants automatically. Tie to Optimize recommendations.
- Evaluate whether autoscaler should expose a "burst credit" metric in console to explain temporary latency spike behavior.
- For migration playbook: step 1) enable canary for 1% traffic, 2) monitor key metrics for 6 hours, 3) increase to 10% if stable, 4) full rollout with 30m wait windows.

Links & refs:
- Confluence: Smart Routing v2 (see design notes and perf table) — https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Smart+Routing+v2
- Jira: PROD-4821 (canary infra work)
- GitHub: runtime PR with hotfix for kv-cache behavior — https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789
- Slack thread: #prod-launch (notes attached, link above)

End-of-day plan:
- Merge PRD edits, ping reviewers.
- Triage infra perf results and update acceptance criteria if needed.
- Draft initial rollback playbook skeleton for CS to iterate.

Random TODOs (personal):
- Ping HR about new contractor onboarding schedule.
- Move lunch meeting if needed (12:30 slot)
